variance_scope: Replicate validator endpoint RGB/Y decrease for raw absorption, plus fixed geometry ROI diagnostics. Deterministic vacuum/outside exempt.
uncertainty_scope: 20000 whole seed-pair bootstrap draws, nonlinear ratio of mean pixel RGB images. Independent backends. Regional bootstrap95/t-jackknife95 union expanded by analytic oracle mean enclosure. Four seeds; no pixel-independence standard errors.

engine_absorption.scope: Cumulative engine checkpoint wall time including earlier checkpoint I/O; job includes process startup

engine_vacuum.scope: Cumulative engine checkpoint wall time including earlier checkpoint I/O; job includes process startup

pbrt_absorption.scope: Complete CPU PBRT process including loading/render/output; analysis overlapped, not isolated

pbrt_vacuum.scope: Complete CPU PBRT process including loading/render/output; analysis overlapped, not isolated

timing_scope: Record only: engine cumulative checkpoint and PBRT complete process timers differ; CPU oracle/analysis overlapped. Not isolated stage4 performance.
limitations: Only matched achromatic constant-density absorption/vacuum is tested here. No scattering, phase, arbitrary heterogeneity or stage3 showcase claim.
Quadrature refinement and analytic enclosure are independent. Float64 roundoff cushion is not formal directed-rounding proof.
Historical engineering tolerances were fixed before full-cohort analysis but root exploratory first-seed values were known; this is not blinded precommit.
